scores.question: Which agreements contain a non-compete clause?
expected: ClickstreamCorp_20200330_1-A_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_12089935_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_Development Agreement.pdf
scores.answer:
The following agreements contain substantive non-compete restrictions:

- **BICYCLETHERAPEUTICSPLC_03_10_2020-EX-10.11-SERVICE AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 14 restricts competing employment and business dealings for 12 months after termination. [BICYCLETHERAPEUTICSPLC_03_10_2020-EX-10.11-SERVICE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 13]
- **BIOAMBERINC_04_10_2013-EX-10.34-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (1).pdf** — Section 13.9, “Bioamber Non-Compete Commitment,” restricts development of alternative succinic-acid biocatalysts during the agreement’s term. [BIOAMBERINC_04_10_2013-EX-10.34-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (1).pdf p. 11]
- **ClickstreamCorp_20200330_1-A_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_12089935_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_Development Agreement.pdf** — Section 7(b)(7) prohibits the developer from developing, maintaining or marketing a similar platform or competing directly or indirectly worldwide. [ClickstreamCorp_20200330_1-A_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_12089935_EX1A-6 MAT CTRCT_Development Agreement.pdf p. 3]
- **DRIVENDELIVERIES,INC_05_22_2020-EX-10.4-CONSULTING AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 4.2, “Covenant Not to Compete,” addresses consulting, services and employment with competing businesses during the term. [DRIVENDELIVERIES,INC_05_22_2020-EX-10.4-CONSULTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **DYNAMEXINC_06_06_1996-EX-10.4-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF** — Article 42, “Non-Competition,” restricts providing similar services for six or twelve months following specified termination events. [DYNAMEXINC_06_06_1996-EX-10.4-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF p. 11]
- **VertexEnergyInc_20200113_8-K_EX-10.1_11943624_EX-10.1_Marketing Agreement.pdf** — Section 9 prohibits competing activities in the defined area during the term and for two years afterward. [VertexEnergyInc_20200113_8-K_EX-10.1_11943624_EX-10.1_Marketing Agreement.pdf p. 10]

Related, narrower restrictions also appear in:

- **LEGACYTECHNOLOGYHOLDINGS,INC_12_09_2005-EX-10.2-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 14 prohibits using proprietary information to engage in business competitive with the other party. [LEGACYTECHNOLOGYHOLDINGS,INC_12_09_2005-EX-10.2-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **LOGANSROADHOUSEINC_03_27_1998-EX-10.17-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF** — Sections 1 and 3(A) prohibit competing sponsorships and driving for competing sponsors. [LOGANSROADHOUSEINC_03_27_1998-EX-10.17-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]

- [LEGACYTECHNOLOGYHOLDINGS,INC_12_09_2005-EX-10.2-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1] — Appoints Envision as the exclusive worldwide distributor for the product blended with krill oil, subject to marketing requirements.

- [SimplicityEsportsGamingCompany_20181130_8-K_EX-10.1_11444071_EX-10.1_Franchise Agreement.pdf p. 3] — Grants territorial trademark exclusivity and restricts the franchisee from partnering with third parties on similar gaming centers.

**Exclusive license grants**

- [ArtaraTherapeuticsInc_20200110_8-K_EX-10.5_11943350_EX-10.5_License Agreement.pdf p. 7] — Grants an exclusive license to use program data for specified purposes and an exclusive regulatory right of reference.
- [BIOAMBERINC_04_10_2013-EX-10.34-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (1).pdf p. 7] [BIOAMBERINC_04_10_2013-EX-10.34-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (1).pdf p. 8] — Grants reciprocal exclusive licenses within their stated scopes.

scores.question: Which agreements are perpetual, with no fixed end date?
scores.answer:
The following agreements have **no fixed end date**, continuing unless terminated:

- **DYNAMEXINC_06_06_1996-EX-10.4-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 2.1 expressly states that it “shall continue indefinitely” until either party terminates it under the agreement. [DYNAMEXINC_06_06_1996-EX-10.4-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]
- **BICYCLETHERAPEUTICSPLC_03_10_2020-EX-10.11-SERVICE AGREEMENT.PDF** — Employment continues unless and until either party gives notice under paragraph 11. [BICYCLETHERAPEUTICSPLC_03_10_2020-EX-10.11-SERVICE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **DOMINIADVISORTRUST_02_18_2005-EX-99.(H)(2)-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF** — Continues unless terminated; either party may terminate on at least 60 days’ written notice. [DOMINIADVISORTRUST_02_18_2005-EX-99.(H)(2)-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **SimplicityEsportsGamingCompany_20181130_8-K_EX-10.1_11444071_EX-10.1_Franchise Agreement.pdf** — Section 2 states that the term continues until terminated as provided in the agreement. [SimplicityEsportsGamingCompany_20181130_8-K_EX-10.1_11444071_EX-10.1_Franchise Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **ArtaraTherapeuticsInc_20200110_8-K_EX-10.5_11943350_EX-10.5_License Agreement.pdf** — The term provision sets no fixed expiration date and permits ArTara to terminate on 30 days’ prior written notice. [ArtaraTherapeuticsInc_20200110_8-K_EX-10.5_11943350_EX-10.5_License Agreement.pdf p. 12]
